label: Cursor
description: Cursor API key + Cursor coding agent for Settings → LLMs. Install from Store → Gateways, then enable to show Cursor under Providers.

steps.title: Open Cursor
steps.body: Press the Cursor row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste a key or use the Cursor coding agent.

steps.title: API key or Cursor agent
steps.body: Paste your Cursor API key here to use Cursor models in Ducky chats. No key? Skip this and use the Cursor coding agent on this same slide.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key. Using the Cursor agent without a key? Press Skip.

steps.title: Cursor agent
steps.body: This is the Cursor coding agent. Detect finds the CLI. Keep it on to pick Cursor in chat.
